_note: OSV-schema sample (https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/). Record 1 is a real-ecosystem advisory shape (PyPI) to show schema fidelity; record 2 is a DEMO advisory whose affected purl matches a fleet part (pkg:generic/raspberrypi/rp2040) so the vuln-match join produces a hit. In production this file is replaced by a download from api.osv.dev (POST /v1/query per purl) or an OSV bucket dump.
